$comment: Correction records in docs/specs, from scripts/audit-corrections.mjs (npm run audit:corrections -- --check; CI runs it). A spec that records what its draft got wrong carries a verdict here saying what CAUGHT it -- execution, reasoning, or provenance -- or not-a-correction when the detector over-matched. --check fails on a detected record missing here AND on a row no longer detected, so the file always enumerates exactly the corpus. The detector is deliberately over-inclusive; the markers are in the script, which is their only home. Seed and method: docs/spec-correction-taxonomy-2026-09-11.md. Spec: docs/specs/correction-record-ratchet.spec.md.
